title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and bump GH actions/deps
author: Jordan Patel
body: Summary: Consolidate multiple GitHub Actions workflows (lint, test, release automation) into a smaller set of purpose-driven workflows to reduce duplication, improve cache hit rates, and make dependency bumping and action upgrades easier to manage. Motivation: We currently have ~8 overlapping workflows across packages and root that duplicate matrix setup and cache logic. This causes inconsistent failures, longer queue times, and fragmented release automation. This PR centralizes common steps into a shared composite action and a smaller set of repository-level workflows, upgrades GH Actions and major action versions, and cleans up obsolete workflow files. Goals: 1) Reduce workflow duplication and simplify maintenance. 2) Improve cache key hygiene to increase cache hits. 3) Upgrade actions (setup-node, actions/cache, actions/checkout) to latest stable versions to address security/hygiene warnings. 4) Make release automation deterministic by consolidating tag/release logic and adding better retry/guard rails. Changes: - Add .github/actions/ci-common composite action that contains matrix setup, cache restore/save, and node/npm/poetry install helpers. - Replace per-package lint/test workflow files with two consolidated workflows: .github/workflows/lint-and-test.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml. - Upgrade setup-node from v3 -> v4, actions/cache v3 -> v4, actions/checkout v3 -> v4 and bump several community actions used by release automation. - Standardize Node versions matrix to [18, 20] and pin major versions for reproducible builds. - Improve cache keys to include OS, node-version, and package-lock hash where applicable. - Add workflow_dispatch inputs and scheduled weekly dependency-bump job. - Remove legacy per-package workflow files: .github/workflows/package-a-lint.yml, .github/workflows/package-b-test.yml (deleted). - Add small docs section in CONTRIBUTING.md about running workflows locally and cache debugging. Checklist: - [x] Composite action implemented and unit-tested via dry-run. - [x] Workflows updated and test runs validated. - [x] Actions versions bumped and smoke-tested. - [x] Release workflow tested in a canary repo. Testing & CI: - First run (2026-02-13) had an intermittent cache miss and one flaky test (integration/test-cli::test_init) failing under Node 18 on ubuntu-latest. - Re-ran job for the failed matrix cell after adding a targeted test timeout and the rerun passed. - Full CI (all matrix cells) passed on 2026-02-14 after cache key fixes and test timeout guard. Risk & Rollback: - Low risk to runtime code. Changes are CI infra and docs. If issues are found we can revert the .github/workflows to the previous commit and re-enable per-package workflows. Migration notes: - Developers should update local CI scripts if they had custom workflow expectations; CONTRIBUTING.md updated with notes. Commits summary: - "create(ci): add composite ci-common action for shared steps" - "chore(ci): consolidate lint and test workflows into lint-and-test.yml" - "chore(ci): consolidate release automation into release.yml and add guard rails" - "chore(ci): bump actions: setup-node@v4, cache@v4, checkout@v4" - "docs: add CI troubleshooting to CONTRIBUTING.md" Files changed (high-level): - .github/actions/ci-common/action.yml (new) - .github/workflows/lint-and-test.yml (new) - .github/workflows/release.yml (new) - .github/workflows/package-a-lint.yml (deleted) - .github/workflows/package-b-test.yml (deleted) - CONTRIBUTING.md (updated) - package.json (root) (pin node matrix) - .github/dependabot.yml (updated schedule) Review conversation (high level): - Lena Morris: "Can we ensure the cache key includes package-lock.json/hash to avoid invalid caches across package changes?" Reply (Jordan): "Added package-lock hash to cache key and re-ran full matrix — see updated cache key in ci-common/action.yml." - Ethan Park: "The release workflow previously relied on a custom script that set multiple tags; does consolidation preserve tag semantics?" Reply (Jordan): "Yes — release.yml preserves multi-tag logic and adds explicit retry and dry-run gating. I also added an integration test in the canary repo and linked logs." - Priya Nair: "One flaky test observed on Node 18 — please timebox and add retry/timeout." Reply (Jordan): "Added 30s timeout and single retry for the flaky integration test; rerun went green." CI checks summary: - lint-and-test matrix: pass (all cells green after rerun) - integration suite: pass - dependency-bump-schedule workflow: queued/passed - release dry-run: pass - security-scan (dependabot alerts): pass Merge: Squash and merge to main on 2026-02-15. Release notes: "CI: Consolidate lint/test/release workflows; bump GH Actions and improve cache keys for faster CI and better hygiene."
